name: Pinoy Tower 🇵🇭
desc:
WELCOME TO PINOY TOWER! 🇵🇭

Handa ka na bang umakyat?

Subukan ang Pinoy Tower at tingnan kung hanggang saan ang kaya mo! Parkour, timing, at patience ang kailangan para maabot ang tuktok. Maglaro mag-isa o kasama ang friends at challenge kung sino ang unang makakatapos.

🏆 Earn Wins!
Reach the top of the tower and complete the challenge to earn Wins! Show off your progress and see how many wins you can collect.

🌟 Features
🇵🇭 Pinoy-inspired tower
🧗 Challenging stages
🏆 Earn Wins by completing the tower
👥 Play with friends
🎁 Join our group for exclusive perks

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite kung nag-enjoy ka!
